revenue_day.sql: SELECT ("orders_simulatedpayment"."approved_at" AT TIME ZONE %s)::date AS "day", SUM("orders_simulatedpayment"."amount") AS "amount", COUNT("orders_simulatedpayment"."id") AS "paid_orders" FROM "orders_simulatedpayment" INNER JOIN "orders_order" ON ("orders_simulatedpayment"."order_id" = "orders_order"."id") WHERE ("orders_simulatedpayment"."approved_at" >= %s AND "orders_simulatedpayment"."approved_at" < %s AND "orders_simulatedpayment"."is_simulated" AND "orders_order"."status" IN (%s, %s, %s)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 ASC

revenue_year.sql: SELECT ("orders_simulatedpayment"."approved_at" AT TIME ZONE %s)::date AS "day", SUM("orders_simulatedpayment"."amount") AS "amount", COUNT("orders_simulatedpayment"."id") AS "paid_orders" FROM "orders_simulatedpayment" INNER JOIN "orders_order" ON ("orders_simulatedpayment"."order_id" = "orders_order"."id") WHERE ("orders_simulatedpayment"."approved_at" >= %s AND "orders_simulatedpayment"."approved_at" < %s AND "orders_simulatedpayment"."is_simulated" AND "orders_order"."status" IN (%s, %s, %s)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 ASC

top_products_day.sql: SELECT "orders_orderitem"."product_id" AS "product_id", "catalog_product"."sku" AS "sku", "catalog_product"."name" AS "name", SUM("orders_orderitem"."quantity") AS "units_sold", SUM(("orders_orderitem"."quantity" * "orders_orderitem"."unit_price")) AS "simulated_revenue" FROM "orders_orderitem" INNER JOIN "catalog_product" ON ("orders_orderitem"."product_id" = "catalog_product"."id") WHERE "orders_orderitem"."order_id" IN (SELECT U0."order_id" AS "order_id" FROM "orders_simulatedpayment" U0 INNER JOIN "orders_order" U1 ON (U0."order_id" = U1."id") WHERE (U0."approved_at" >= %s AND U0."approved_at" < %s AND U0."is_simulated" AND U1."status" IN (%s, %s, %s))) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 4 DESC, 1 ASC LIMIT 20
